title: Scope rename workbench suggestion destinations
summary: Scopes Rename Filter Case Workbench suggestion destination dropdowns to the selected media type so movie cases expose only movie destinations and TV cases expose only TV destinations.
reason: The workbench dropdown was offering both movie and TV filter destinations for every suggestion, which let operators stage terms into the wrong media policy.
behavior_before: Every suggestion row offered ignore, movie custom/filter destinations, and TV custom/filter destinations regardless of whether the case was a movie or TV case.
behavior_after: Movie suggestion rows offer ignore plus movie destinations only; TV suggestion rows offer ignore plus TV destinations only. Backend suggestion metadata remains read-only until the operator stages and saves through Settings.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_facade_rename_policy.py: asserts movie suggestion destination lists exclude TV destinations and TV suggestion destination lists exclude movie destinations
manual_validation: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.change_control.validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage -- failed because 11 unrelated generated dependency-atlas/summary files are changed and not listed in any unreleased change packet
rollback_plan: Restore the previous all-destination suggestion list in filename_preview.py, revert the contract/docs wording and unit assertions, then rerun the focused rename policy/API and browser smoke tests.
